import json, random, struct, subprocess, sys, time, zlib

rng = random.Random(7)
def mkrec(seq, kind, txn, payload):
    hdr = struct.pack("<IIBI", len(payload), seq, kind, txn)
    return hdr + payload + struct.pack("<I", zlib.crc32(hdr + payload) & 0xffffffff)

def big_log(seed):
    r = random.Random(seed)
    parts = []; seq = 0; size = 0
    txns = {}
    while size < 64000:
        seq += 1
        kind = r.choice([1,2,2,2,3,4])
        txn = r.randint(1, 6)
        if kind == 2:
            cnt = r.randint(1, 8)
            payload = struct.pack("<HHH", 0, r.randint(0, 64-cnt), cnt) + bytes(cnt)
            if txn in txns: txns[txn].append(payload)
        elif kind == 3:
            ps = txns.pop(txn, [])
            d = 0
            for p in ps: d = zlib.crc32(p, d) & 0xffffffff
            payload = struct.pack("<II", len(ps), d)
        else:
            payload = b""
            if kind == 1: txns[txn] = []
            else: txns.pop(txn, None)
        rec = mkrec(seq, kind, txn, payload)
        parts.append(rec); size += len(rec)
    return b"".join(parts).hex()

NREQ = 800
reqs = []
for i in range(NREQ):
    reqs.append({"pages": ["%0128d" % 0][:0] or ["00"*64]*4, "checkpoint": i % 50, "log": big_log(i)})
inp = "".join(json.dumps(r) + "\n" for r in reqs)
print(f"input size: {len(inp)/1e6:.1f} MB, {NREQ} requests")
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/app/main.py"], input=inp, text=True, capture_output=True, cwd="/app")
dt = time.time() - t0
assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr
lines = p.stdout.splitlines()
